tables.name: tariff

tables.description: A network tariff code in effect for a period, with its name and customer class as published and whether its rates are provisional (AER) or final (the distributor's own list). A tariff with no rate rows is one its document lists with every price zero.

customer_class IS NULL OR customer_class_published IS NOT NULL

tables.name: tariff_link
tables.grain: one stated relation of one tariff period to another tariff code or customer class
tables.source: built by scripts/tariffdb/build.py: alias and zone_variant_of from the AER spellings the build stores under the distributor's code (data/tariffdb/code_alias.csv); the rest from data/tariffdb/curated/*.yaml, quoted
tables.description: How a tariff relates to others: the AER's spelling of it, the tariff a customer may opt out to, the tariff it replaces, a primary tariff it must sit beside, a tariff it may not be combined with ... linked_code is a code as printed and need not be a stored tariff.

tables.name: season_part
tables.grain: one span of dates of one season, repeating every year
tables.description: A span of a season, from a start day to an end day (inclusive), each a calendar day or the day daylight saving starts or ends. A span may wrap the year end (1 November to 31 March).
checks: part_no > 0
(start_month IS NULL) = (start_day IS NULL)
(end_month IS NULL) = (end_day IS NULL)
(start_month IS NULL) = (start_anchor IS NOT NULL)
(end_month IS NULL) = (end_anchor IS NOT NULL)
start_month IS NULL OR start_month BETWEEN 1 AND 12
end_month IS NULL OR end_month BETWEEN 1 AND 12
start_day IS NULL OR start_day BETWEEN 1 AND 31
end_day IS NULL OR end_day BETWEEN 1 AND 31
